text:
Priya: Heads-up: Polaris Labs showing a steady decline in active workflows (20% w/w) and a looming renewal in 36 days. Risk signal from usage + NPS comment about onboarding friction. Thinking a short-term 'Rescue Lane' + downgrade-protection offer.
Diego: can you share the main failure modes? Integration, prompts, training? :mag_right:
Priya: mainly onboarding friction and two failing webhooks that drop nightly. Usage concentrated in Search + Rerank flows.
Hana: I can run a rapid enablement sprint. Proposed: 1) 20-min discovery w/ CSM + SE 2) quick sandbox with preloaded examples 3) 1-hr troubleshooting session 4) 10-day observation window.
Arjun: if webhooks are failing nightly we should open an eng ticket immediately. Also recommend a temporary route-restriction so they keep critical endpoints available if they downgrade.
Priya: draft customer note below 1: please review and suggest tone edits.
Priya: ```Hi <Customer>,
We noticed a 20% drop in active workflows and a recurring webhook failure overnight. We'd like to offer a 45-day Rescue Lane: 15% account credit, a preconfigured sandbox seat, and a technical session with our solutions engineer to resolve the webhook issue. No permanent contract changes required; if you choose to remain on the plan we'll reassess at the end of the period. Are you available for a short call next week?
Thanks,
Priya (CSM)```
Diego: keep it concise and add the data point. Also add a short bullets checklist for customer: logs + sample request IDs + preferred timezone.
Priya: updated template:```Hi <Customer>,
We observed a 20% drop in active workflows and an overnight webhook error. Wed like to offer a 45-day Rescue Lane (15% credit + sandbox seat) and a 30-min technical triage with our SE. Action items: [ ] Confirm a 30-min slot [ ] Share failing webhook timestamps + sample request IDs [ ] Accept Rescue Lane. No contract change; we'll reassess after 45 days.
Best,
Priya```
Hana: SE can prepare a playbook: quick verification steps, common webhook misconfigs, and a rollback checklist. I'll make a 1-pager.
Arjun: creating ENG ticket now: `ENG-4821` tag: polaris-webhook. Priority P2. Please include failing timestamps and environment (staging/prod). I'll ping eng-oncall for a short sync.
Diego: finance ok to approve up to $1.5k/month credits for midmarket retention. Ill confirm for this account and flag any exceptions.
reminder-bot: Calendar invite created for Polaris Rescue Call — Wed 16:00 UTC (created by Priya)
Priya: timeline: customer email today, call scheduled by EOD Tue, enablement within 48h post-call, health check at day 10, renewal outreach at day 25.
Hana: I'll draft the pre-call checklist and include this curl snippet for them to run and paste results:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"sample":true}'
```
Arjun: when they send logs ask for the exact UTC timestamps + request IDs. That reduces back-and-forth. Also include stack traces if available.
Diego: note for billing: if they move to a lower tier during the Rescue Lane, keep critical routes enabled via feature flags and attach a billing note to revert credits in case of abuse.
Priya: assigning owners: Hana d playbook & precall deck (due 6h), Arjun d eng ticket & oncall ping (due 2h), Diego d finance approval (due 10h). I'll send the customer message once finance confirms the credit.
Hana: ACK. I'll share a short Loom + 1-pager here once ready.
Priya: thanks team :heart: will update thread when finance confirms and when playbook link is posted.
